Macrons

Consonantal i

Construction, trades & building materials

guardrail noun

also guardrails, rail, parapet, breastwork

our formation

repāgula, repāgulōrum n. pl.

noun, second declension, plural

bars, barriers

Ancient especially for door bars; our functional extension to guardrails. Not asserted to be a standardized modern scaffold-component term.

Other words

  • ferrum trānsversum ad marginem tabulātī positum — one metal rail placed at the edge of the deck

    also used · our formation

    A description, not asserted to be a standardized modern scaffold-component term.

  • pluteus, pluteī m. — breastwork, parapet on towers

    noun, second declension · also used · classical · Caesar, BG 7.41 (Lewis & Short)

    A closer ancient word for a parapet.

  • lōrīca, lōrīcae f. — breastwork, parapet

    noun, first declension · also used · classical · Caesar (Lewis & Short)

    A closer ancient word for a parapet.

See also scaffold platform, crossbar.
